usedFor: Zoho Inventory holds items and sales orders, and Instagram for Business receives a post through “Publish Instagram Story”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item” in Zoho Inventory, then “Publish Instagram Story” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: A new item can go out as a Story, using a photo or video from a public URL.

watchOut: “Publish Instagram Story” posts publicly, so the post waits in Needs you for approval.
